segments.text: Diễn giả 1: Section 2.
Diễn giả 1: You will hear a manager called Mark Bergin, who works for a large retailer called Johnson Jones, giving a talk at a recruitment fair.
Diễn giả 1: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 15 on page 3.
Diễn giả 1: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 15.
Diễn giả 2: Good morning.
Diễn giả 2: My name's Mark Bergin.
Diễn giả 2: I'm a human resources manager at Johnson Jones and I'm here to tell you about what it's like working for one of the country's best employers.
Diễn giả 2: The company has 225 department stores and owns a further 150 supermarkets.
Diễn giả 2: At our latest store opening, we had over 9,000 applicants for 750 posts.
Diễn giả 2: So why do so many people want to work for us?
Diễn giả 2: The first thing that attracts them isn't so much the salary, although that is a little above average.
Diễn giả 2: It's the idea of getting a massive 25% off everything from washing machines to designer handbags.
Diễn giả 2: People are prepared to put in long hours to get those kinds of perks.
Diễn giả 2: Johnson Jones has been going strong for nearly 150 years.
Diễn giả 2: And has outlived many of its strongest competitors.
Diễn giả 2: Of course, this has something to do with the high-quality products that we sell and our motto, better for less, which means customers know they are getting good value for money.
Diễn giả 2: But we're not alone in that.
Diễn giả 2: Where we are different is in our approach to making a profit.
Diễn giả 2: Other companies think in the short term, whereas we always take a more strategic view, looking three or five years ahead.
Diễn giả 2: The company isn't owned by a family or shareholders.
Diễn giả 2: It's a partnership, which means it's owned by its full-time employees, who are all partners and have a share in the company.
Diễn giả 2: In return for the very generous benefits they get, they're expected to put in extra effort and take an active role in running the company.
Diễn giả 2: This means they're involved in things like making decisions about pension contributions for example.
Diễn giả 2: Another very attractive reason for working for us is the annual bonus which we get as a percentage of our salary.
Diễn giả 2: Last year it was 15%, about two months' salary, which is pretty standard.
Diễn giả 2: It can go down to 8%, but that's unusual, and a couple of times it's even been above 20%.
Diễn giả 2: Some people use it to pay off loans, others save it for a deposit on a house.
Diễn giả 2: The most popular benefit for partners are the subsidised holiday centres, which are owned by the company.
Diễn giả 2: Once a year, partners can book in for up to two weeks.
Diễn giả 2: It's for anyone, from cleaners to directors, with a minimum of three months' service.
Diễn giả 2: After six months' service, partners are entitled to a further subsidy on the cost of their stay.
Diễn giả 1: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions 16 to 20 on page 4.
Diễn giả 1: Now listen and answer questions 16 to 20.
Diễn giả 2: Let me just give you an idea of what's on offer at the holiday centres.
Diễn giả 2: The Grange, which is the largest of the holiday centres, is used for conferences by the company, and the board of directors always have their annual meeting there.
Diễn giả 2: It's all very informal, not like a normal conference centre.
Diễn giả 2: Meadow House is located in Kent, which is famous for its apples and other fruit, and it's a large country house.
Diễn giả 2: What's unusual about it is that, unlike other hotels, you have access to the kitchen, so it feels more like staying with a friend.
Diễn giả 2: Combe Manor is a working farm.
Diễn giả 2: There are loads of cows and sheep, none of which actually end up on our supermarket shelves,
Diễn giả 2: It's a paradise for kids as there's plenty of space to run wild and also an indoor pool.
Diễn giả 2: You can choose to stay in cottages or camp by the lake.
Diễn giả 2: The barn is where I recently celebrated my 25th wedding anniversary.
Diễn giả 2: You can rent the whole place out for a large group of up to 40 friends.
Diễn giả 2: We got all our food delivered from the nearest Johnson Jones supermarket, so there was no cooking to be done.
Diễn giả 2: Perfect.
Diễn giả 2: All that was missing was the spa, which should be opening next year.
Diễn giả 2: The stable is often hard to get into because it's so popular.
Diễn giả 2: That's partly because it's right on the beach with beautiful sea views and only an hour by train from London.
Diễn giả 2: Ideal for weekends.
Diễn giả 2: The company sailing club is located there, which was started by the company's founder in 1885.
Diễn giả 1: That is the end of Section 2.
Diễn giả 1: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
Diễn giả 1: Now turn to section 3 on page 5.
